international.title: Boots to begin prescribing medical cannabis in UK
international.summary: Online service will be offered to patients with eligible conditions, in a first for a British high street pharmacy Boots is to start prescribing medical cannabis, it has announced, in a first for a UK high street pharmacy. The online service is being offered to patients in the UK aged 25 and older who have an eligible condition such as chronic pain, anxiety or insomnia. Continue reading...
